name: Kitano Kojirou
source:
He and the main character are best and worst friends. They have been friends for 12 years since first grade elementary school.

He is an only son. He pretends to be a student at a film school and often hangs out in the main character's room. He used to be part of a bad boy duo with the main character, called "The Rocket brothers".  Nowadays he's a playboy who combined smooth talking and comedy.

He always wears tinted glasses, but he has no sister. The fake fur he wears around his neck seems to be popular at parties, and costs 6,980 yen at “Tokyo Autobahn,” where you can find everything.

[from [url=http://autobahn69.jp/Autobahn/lovemilf.html] official site]
